summary: WP-003 is a pure verification work package (no files modified). Review covers the upstream code changes from WP-001 and WP-002 as validated by this stage.

WP-001 (scripts/build-personas.js): (1) Dead cc_model: sharedMeta.cc_model assignment confirmed absent — grep returns no matches; (2) All three model-emitting frontmatter templates now use single-quoted model values (lines 420, 438, 464); (3) Model resolution chain correctly simplified to `sharedMeta.default_model || 'inherit'` — legacy || sharedMeta.cc_model removed; (4) ccModel escape hatch preserved intact: `persona.cc_model !== undefined ? persona.cc_model : model`; (5) Context object ordering is unambiguous — shared meta, then ...persona spread, then explicit computed overrides.

WP-002 (_shared.yaml files): ledger file retains default_model: 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' with inline comment, cc_model field absent; standalone file gains default_model: 'inherit', cc_model absent. Minimal, surgical YAML edits.
WP-003 verification: all 34 personas built clean under --strict, --check confirms no stale output, role parity passes, negative grep confirms zero unquoted model: values across all output dirs.
No blocking issues found across any of the three work packages.

comments.note: FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC (line 429) and FRONTMATTER_STANDALONE_CC (line 456) share verbatim YAML fragments: permissionMode, model, and memory appear in both CC templates. A small template-composition helper (or a shared CC-fields partial) would eliminate future drift risk as the template set grows. Not blocking — both templates are currently consistent.

scripts/build-personas.js --suite flag defaults to 'ledger'. A plain `node scripts/build-personas.js` silently skips standalone personas, which could surprise contributors expecting a complete rebuild. Consider defaulting to --suite all, or emitting a visible console note listing omitted suites when the default is used.

personas/standalone/src/meta/_shared.yaml: the newly added default_model: 'inherit' field has no inline comment. The equivalent ledger file has `# Default model for all agents; override per-persona (mirrors default_version)`. Adding a matching comment to the standalone file would improve discoverability for future contributors.

node scripts/build-personas.js --check only validates the 14 ledger suite output files. The 20 standalone output files are not covered. If standalone templates drift without a full --suite all rebuild, --check will not detect it. Expanding --check coverage to all suites would close this gap.

summary: WP-003 is a pure verification work package — no new files were modified by the implementation. All core documentation changes (api-surface.md, data-flows.md, constraints.md schema tables and frontmatter templates) were applied during the WP-001 documentation pass and confirmed accurate for WP-002.

Addressed three documentation gaps surfaced by WP-003 reviewers: (1) personas/standalone/src/meta/_shared.yaml — added inline comment to default_model field matching the ledger file style; (2) constraints.md constraint 3 — rewrote to make clear that bare node scripts/build-personas.js defaults to --suite ledger and silently skips standalone; (3) constraints.md constraint 43 — added a 'Ledger-only scope' callout noting the pre-commit hook only validates 14 ledger suite files.

Verified all previously-documented changes (WP-001 and WP-002) remain accurate against the current codebase: frontmatter templates carry single-quoted model values, no cc_model in _shared.yaml schema tables, correct resolution chains in constraint 28c and data-flows.md Layer 3.

comments.note: WP-003 is a verification-only WP (no new files). The documentation surface is clean after the WP-001 and WP-002 passes. The three updates made here close gaps flagged by the code reviewer: standalone _shared.yaml comment, --suite default caveats (constraint 3), and pre-commit hook scope (constraint 43).

The cc_model per-persona escape hatch (persona.cc_model → model fallback) is preserved and documented in constraint 28c and data-flows.md Layer 3, but no persona YAML currently sets cc_model. An inline code comment in build-personas.js near the ccModel ternary would help future developers avoid removing it as dead code — flagged by both QA and Reviewer; tracked as a build-script improvement outside this project scope.
